translationRules.translatesNeverRedefines: An adapter maps framework behavior onto a native surface. It never changes what a control means, only how it is expressed.
translationRules.noAuthorityOrigination: An adapter never becomes an authority. It cannot approve, cannot classify risk, and cannot resolve a source conflict.
translationRules.noProjectGovernance: An adapter carries no project-specific governance. Project rules live in the Profile, not the adapter.
translationRules.noStateInvention: An adapter may not invent, rename, merge, skip, or reorder a governed lifecycle state or gate.
translationRules.noIndependenceCollapse: An adapter may not collapse required independent steps into one invocation for convenience.

capabilityMap.translationNote: Turns map to work on a work item; the item, not the thread, holds state
Files exchanged as artifacts; durable state is externalized packages, not thread memory
Continuity snapshots carry state across context limits
Tool availability mapped to role permissions where the surface allows
Fresh conversation with curated bundle satisfies SEPARATE_INVOCATION_CLEAN_CONTEXT
Conversational surface has no per-role tool isolation
capabilityMap.mitigation: Tool-permission matrix is declarative here; enforcement via the GitHub/CI adapter. Declared in the Step 41 compatibility matrix.

prohibitions: Thread memory is never treated as durable state
Conversational fluency is never treated as evidence
A relabeled continuation of the same thread never satisfies independent review

evidenceTranslation.rule: Evidence is produced by reproducible scripts and exported as artifacts, never asserted in prose. A claim in the conversation is not an evidence record.

handoffTranslation.rule: Handoff = exported continuation package with SHA256SUMS. Receiver validates the package before resuming.

lifecycleSyncRule: The conversation reflects the work item's state; it never holds a competing state.
